user.title: Spot price source
user.description: Pick the ha-electricityinfo-nz price sensors for your ICP's node.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names.

data_description.forecast_entity: Optional. Used for the forecast price sensors.

category.title: Categories
category.description: Use the codes on your ICP's Electricity Authority registry record, or the ones your bill charges for ({network}).

retailer.title: Retailer plan
retailer.description: Per-kWh values in c/kWh, daily values in NZD/day, all ex GST. Add later changes as rate versions in the options.

data_description.import_margin: Added to the spot price on import, before losses.
data_description.export_margin: Taken off the spot price on export.
data_description.transmission: The retailer's per-kWh transmission line on the bill.
data_description.export_floor: Leave empty if export can go negative with spot.

add_retailer_version.title: Add retailer rate version
add_retailer_version.description: The new values apply from the date you pick; earlier periods keep the rates in force then (latest version: {latest}). Per-kWh values in c/kWh, ex GST.

data_description.import_margin: Added to the spot price on import, before losses.
data_description.export_margin: Taken off the spot price on export.
data_description.transmission: The retailer's per-kWh transmission line on the bill.
data_description.export_floor: Leave empty if export can go negative with spot.

add_network_override.title: Override network values
add_network_override.description: Replace bundled network values from a date until the next bundled schedule takes effect, e.g. to follow what your bill charges. Per-kWh values in c/kWh, ex GST; leave a field empty to keep the bundled value. The bundled data starts on {first}.

data_description.export_credit_peak: A credit paid to you, entered as a positive number.

data_description.live_entity: Optional. Used for the live price sensors.
data_description.forecast_entity: Optional. Used for the forecast price sensors.

price_at.name: Price at
price_at.description: Returns the landed import and export price for a spot price at a given time, using the rates in force then.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Any time in the trading period to price.

export_versions.name: Export rate versions
export_versions.description: Returns every rate version in force for the ICP as YAML.
